name: The Binding
summary: The Binding is the final trial in an aspiring Horde warlock's quest to enslave a succubus in Orgrimmar. By using the devotion bound up in Dogran's Pendant at Neeru Fireblade's summoning circle, the warlock wrenches a demon from the Twisting Nether and breaks its will through force of arms and spellcraft.

sections.title: A Demon's Anchor
sections.body: To reach across realms and compel a succubus, a summoner requires an anchor—a conduit attuned to the creature's particular nature. The pendant given up by the maimed orc Dogran serves this dark purpose. A keepsake of his love for Zankaja, carried through captivity and torment, the trinket carries the emotional resonance needed to bridge the Twisting Nether and seize a demon's attention.

sections.title: The Circle in the Shadows
sections.body: Beneath the clefts of Orgrimmar, deep within the tent of Neeru Fireblade, lies a summoning circle prepared for such hazardous work. Under the tutelage of Gan'rul Bloodeye, the warlock activates the rune-scribed circle and battles the summoned seductress. A warlock cannot simply call a demon into service; they must overpower it in single combat, bending its malevolent spirit to their sovereign will.

sections.title: Wiles and Willpower
sections.body: As Gan'rul warns, succubi are perilous thralls. While their presence intoxicates and tempts the senses, they steadily drain the vitality and spirit of careless masters. Gan'rul bids the warlock remember the sorrow of Dogran and Zankaja as a guard against the demon's wiles, for pride and overconfidence have overcome many a promising warlock. True mastery demands an unyielding will that never succumbs to the demon's allure.

aliases: what do you do in the binding
faq.answer: The warlock brings Dogran's Pendant into the summoning circle inside Neeru Fireblade's tent in the Cleft of Shadows. Using the devotion bound up in the talisman, the summoner calls forth a succubus from the Twisting Nether and battles it to submission to establish total dominion over the creature.

faq.q: Where does the summoning take place?
aliases: where do i summon the succubus
faq.answer: The summoning takes place in the Cleft of Shadows in Orgrimmar, specifically within the tent of Neeru Fireblade, where a permanent ritual circle is inscribed into the floor.

faq.q: Who was Dogran and why is his pendant needed?
faq.answer: Dogran was a Horde grunt captured and maimed by the quilboar in the Barrens. His pendant, a keepsake tied to his beloved Zankaja, serves as the essential focal point needed to lure and anchor a succubus.

Gan'rul Bloodeye is a senior warlock trainer residing in the Cleft of Shadows beneath Orgrimmar. He mentors rising practitioners of the dark arts and guides them through the perilous rites of demon subjugation.

faq.q: What power does a warlock gain upon completing this trial?
faq.answer: Subduing the creature completes the warlock's training, granting them the secret knowledge and runic mastery required to summon a succubus minion into service at any time.

faq.q: Why is summoning a succubus considered especially dangerous?
faq.answer: Succubi wield powerful charms and manipulate the desires of mortals. Overconfident warlocks risk having their souls slowly siphoned away, succumbing to the demon's subtle guile rather than commanding it.

angles.text: This rite marks a warlock's transition into commanding cunning, disruptive demons, proving that personal willpower can dominate the seductive perils of the Nether.
Conducted in secret within the Cleft of Shadows, the ritual highlights the uneasy tolerance Thrall's Horde extends to demonic practitioners hidden away from the city's honor-bound populace.
For orcs, dealing with demonic entities carries the bitter weight of their people's past corruption, making the discipline and control demanded by Gan'rul especially poignant.
